defaultPrompt: Verify my SVGator connection without creating, editing, or exporting any projects.
Help me create an editable SVGator animation. Use the server's motion-design resources and authoring references where available, build the animation, and provide its editor link.
Inspect an existing SVGator animation and help me refine its timing and easing.
interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, refine, and export editable SVG animations through SVGator's hosted MCP server. Connect your own SVGator account through ChatGPT's secure sign-in flow. Projects remain editable in SVGator, and available export formats depend on the connected account's permissions. Developed and maintained by CFMoon as an independent integration; not affiliated with or endorsed by SVGator.
